extraction.experiment: Raising d_k with the 1/√d_k scaling switched off makes each attention row go from spread out to nearly one-hot, and the softmax gradients collapse. This is the effect §3.2.1 gives as the reason for scaling.
extraction.reproduce: With the 1/√d_k scaling, logits keep unit variance and attention stays spread out even at d_k = 512.
extraction.contrast: Without scaling, the same d_k = 512 gives dot products with standard deviation near √d_k, so the softmax saturates toward one-hot and its gradients nearly vanish.
